_comment: Pet UI <-> backend contract: methods and the keys every response carries. Single source for tests/pet-ui/model.test.mjs (on the demo backend) and the backend's own contract test (on real api.py output). See docs/architecture.en.md section 8. Every method returns {ok:true,data} or {ok:false,error,code}.

window.anchor: measured CHAR_RECT clamped to work area; transparent spill may extend off any screen edge

confirm_chime._comment: Sine per note plus a 2x overtone at the given level; linear attack, exponential decay to -80 dB. The backend renders this to pet-confirm.wav (44.1 kHz mono 16-bit) for popup.ps1.
